title: Exact Boundary Enforcement Along Implicit Geometries for Physics-Informed, Deep Learning Problems in Continuum Mechanics
summary: Solutions to well-posed problems in continuum mechanics are continuously dependent upon prescribed boundary conditions. Because of this, variations in the enforcement of boundary data can impact the reliability of inversion techniques that rely on efficient and accurate forward models. To this end, it is necessary to understand how specific boundary implementation techniques can affect the performance of a given forward model.
